steps.title: 3D Digital Imaging
steps.text: We start with a quick, mess-free scan using our iTero scanner to create a high-resolution, interactive map of your smile—no traditional impressions needed.

steps.title: Custom Clear Aligners
steps.text: Your treatment plan is carefully designed to guide your teeth into better alignment using a set of BPA-free plastic aligners made specifically for your mouth.

steps.title: Daily Wear & Routine Care
steps.text: Wear your aligners 20–22 hours a day, removing them only to eat, brush, and floss. You’ll enjoy the flexibility to maintain your normal diet and hygiene routine—something traditional metal braces can’t offer.

steps.title: Progress Monitoring
steps.text: We’ll schedule regular check-ins to ensure your teeth are tracking correctly. As your smile improves, you’ll switch to a new set of aligners every 1–2 weeks.

steps.title: Smile Transformation
steps.text: Most patients complete their clear aligner treatment within 6 to 18 months, depending on the level of correction needed. The result? A straighter, healthier-looking smile with minimal disruption to your lifestyle.

faqs.a: The cost of Invisalign typically ranges from $3,500 to $8,000, depending on your unique treatment needs. Factors like case complexity, treatment length, and insurance coverage all play a role. During your consultation, we’ll provide a personalized estimate and walk you through flexible payment and financing options.

faqs.q: How long does Invisalign treatment take?
faqs.a: Most patients complete treatment within 6 to 18 months, depending on the complexity of the case and how consistently the aligners are worn.

Invisalign is generally more comfortable than traditional braces. You may experience mild pressure or tightness for a day or two when switching to a new set of aligners, but this usually fades quickly.

faqs.q: Can I eat with my aligners in?
faqs.a: No. You should remove your aligners before eating or drinking anything other than water. This helps avoid staining and keeps the aligners clean and effective.

faqs.q: How do I clean my Invisalign trays?
faqs.a: Use a soft toothbrush and clear, gentle soap to clean your aligners daily. Avoid hot water, which can warp the plastic. Specialized Invisalign cleaning crystals are also available.

faqs.q: How often do I need to visit the office during treatment?
faqs.a: You’ll typically visit every 6–8 weeks so your dentist can monitor your progress and provide your next set of aligners. These visits are quick and easy.
Many dental insurance plans with orthodontic benefits will cover part of the cost of Invisalign. Our front desk team can check your benefits and help you understand your coverage.

faqs.q: What’s the difference between Invisalign and traditional braces?
faqs.a: Invisalign uses clear, removable aligners while traditional braces rely on metal brackets and wires. Both are effective, but Invisalign is more discreet and allows for easier cleaning and eating. For a detailed comparison, check out this guide by the American Association of Orthodontists on how clear aligners differ from braces.
